subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for May 15th, departing from JFK International Airport at 10:00 AM. Please arrive at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please contact our customer service team at [Phone Number]. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
